title: Final Probability Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final probability expression for P(1s to 2p) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The perturbation Hamiltonian must be correctly identified as H' = ezE(t).

title: Matrix Elements
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the non-vanishing matrix elements between states of opposite parity.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The integral involving the wave functions must be correctly evaluated, including limits and factors.

title: Transition Rules
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the selection rules for transitions correctly, noting which states contribute.

title: Limiting Behavior
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the limiting behavior of the probability as parameters change.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the calculations.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Pitfall Criteria: The final answer must be presented in a clear and correct format, avoiding typographical errors.
